description: This file implements a tokenizer for parsing source code, including functions for classifying tokens, handling string literals, operators, comments, and managing tokenization state.

classes.name: Tokenizer
classes.description: A class responsible for tokenizing input source code into a sequence of tokens.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: A class or struct representing individual tokens identified during tokenization.

classes.name: Err
classes.description: A class representing error information during tokenization.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: A class representing the location (line and column) within the source input.

methods.name: Tokenize
methods.description: Static method to perform tokenization on an input file.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Performs the tokenization process on the input data.

methods.name: ClassifyToken
methods.description: Classifies a character or sequence as a specific token type.

methods.name: AdvanceToEndOfToken
methods.description: Advances the current position to the end of the current token based on its type.
